sm_top.sm: Bahrain stated it intercepted six drones launched by Iran's IRGC targeting a US radar.
A tanker was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in a reported fire.
Oil tankers caught fire after striking sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Moscow claimed Ukraine launched its largest drone attack against Russia since the beginning of the war.
An Israeli airstrike in Gaza killed a senior Hamas commander.
An Israeli airstrike on Nasser Hospital in Gaza killed 6 people, drawing international condemnation.
Saudi Arabia dismissed the commander of coalition forces fighting the Houthis as government forces withdrew from the Red Sea coast.
Bahrain intercepted Iranian aerial attacks as Tehran claimed it attacked a U.S. base.
A third US aircraft carrier arrives in the Middle East as tensions persist.
Russian authorities report one person killed in Ukrainian drone attacks on Taganrog and Nizhnekamsk.
Coalition forces intercepted multiple Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh and drones over eastern Saudi Arabia.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted Houthi missiles and drones targeting Riyadh and southern Yemen.
Yemeni Houthi forces advanced toward Aden as the government bolstered defenses.
The Iranian military broadcast footage of shooting down a U.S. drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted ballistic missiles and drones targeting Riyadh and other areas in Saudi Arabia.
Ukrainian forces struck Akhtubinsk Airfield, leaving a runway on fire.
Three people were killed as Russia and Ukraine exchanged accusations over overnight attacks.
Russian strikes on Dnipro killed one woman and injured 13 people, two critically.
The Myanmar military bombed an IDP camp in Ponnagyun Township, killing at least 13 people.
Saudi air defenses destroyed ballistic missiles and drones targeting Riyadh.
Taiwan reported that China mobilized more than 100 ships near Taiwan during maneuvers.
Russia launched 96 strike drones at Ukraine, with Ukrainian air defenses intercepting 81, most shot down by F‑16 fighters.
Ukrainian drone onslaught struck the Kerch Strait Bridge.
An Army major filed a complaint alleging the Pentagon ignored threats in Kuwait prior to an Iranian strike that killed six US soldiers.
A Sudanese army airstrike killed 15 people, including children, during an offensive in Kordofan.
A rights group reports that an army airstrike killed at least 13 people in West Kordofan.
Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge, restricting traffic.
An Israeli airstrike in Gaza killed a senior Hamas commander.
Iran claims it carried out a drone attack on a US radar system at a Bahrain military base.
President Zelensky stated that Ukrainian drone attacks have neutralized over 55% of Russia's oil refining capacity.
Fighting and mechanized assaults continue around Dobropillia as Ukrainian forces conduct counterattacks against Russian positions.
Ukrainian Air Force reported guided aerial bombs targeting Zaporizhzhia.
Russia launched a mass attack on Odesa Oblast as Ukraine struck an airfield and drone launch site in Russia.
Houthi forces operationally encircled thousands of PLC/STC soldiers in Lahij Governorate, advancing across a wide front.
The Houthis claim that the Saudi-led coalition carried out airstrikes across Yemen over a 24-hour period.
A revenge attack in South Sudan killed 17 people.
Russian overnight strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure caused power outages across multiple regions.
Russian attacks across nine Ukrainian regions killed at least six people and injured 88 others.
An attack caused a massive explosion and fireball at a Russian missile depot.
An analysis of leaked data indicates around 300 Russian citizens, likely Wagner and Africa Corps mercenaries, have been killed in Mali.
